name: Viana de Jadraque (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Viana de Jadraque (parted, a river and a bridge on green and a church on white).
history: Viana de Jadraque adopted its arms and flag officially on 29 July 2014, published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha on 7 August 2014; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of two equal vertical stripes, white at the hoist and green at the fly, with the arms at the centre, two thirds of the height of the flag.

features.role: Viana de Jadraque arms — parted, river and bridge, and church
